correctness.rationale: For every wheel with m>=3 rim vertices and unrestricted graphic-matroid basis-exchange edges, distance(T,U)=m-|T∩U| by successive fundamental-cycle replacement. Maximizing disjoint-from-T edges equals graphic-matroid rank of H_T=E(W)\T, i.e. m+1-c(H_T); with m edges on m+1 vertices, beta(H_T)=c(H_T)-1 and ecc=m-beta. Every complementary cycle either the whole rim (no spokes) or a hub-plus-rim path; rim degree at most two forces distinct complementary cycles to meet only at the hub, so 3beta<=m. q=floor(m/3) disjoint hub triangles plus r leftover spokes give a complement of a spanning tree attaining q. A complementary spanning-tree pair gives ecc=m. For nonconstant cyclic binary rim words, precisely two alternating boundary-spoke completions yield two spanning trees; monochromatic rim words yield none, giving peripheral 2^(m+1)-4 and unordered pairs 2^m-2. Independent all-tree exact enumeration for m=3..6 checked each eccentricity by actual max over all spanning trees and predicted radius/diameter/count; original finite verifiers separately inspected, not substituted for proof.
